name: Lingnan University
summary: Tuen Mun liberal arts university with 34 programmes across arts, business, social sciences and data science; non-local tuition HK$205,000.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is a recognised qualification with no points minimum set. English: grade 4 in English A, or English B grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL. Ask the IBO to send your results to Lingnan.

dates.label: Final round: application deadline for non-local applicants

programmes.name: Animation and Digital Arts
programmes.about: A creative-arts degree with equal weight on art history and theory and on animation workshops, with concentrations in Digital Animation and in Arts and Technology; it started in 2019/20.
programmes.ib: Non-local applicants meet Lingnan's general IB rule; English at grade 4 (A) or B at HL 4 or SL 5.

needs.note: English B: grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL

programmes.selectionNote: Self-financed and UGC-funded places both exist; ask the department how it ranks non-local applicants.

flagshipSource.title: Animation and Digital Arts: BA (Hons) offered since the 2019/20 academic year (programme page)

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: Eight majors for first-year entry, among them Animation and Digital Arts, Film and Visual Arts, History and Translation.

faculties.name: Faculty of Business
faculties.line: Seven programmes from Accounting and Corporate Governance to Risk and Insurance Management; AACSB-accredited since 2011.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
faculties.line: Ten programmes across economics, government, psychology, sociology and social policy, including Social Data Science.

faculties.name: Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies
faculties.line: Global Development and Sustainability, Public Management and Smart Governance, and Sports Coaching and Event Management.

faculties.name: School of Data Science
faculties.line: Data Science, taught by the Division of Artificial Intelligence and the Division of Industrial Data Science.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: non-local tuition for UGC-funded programmes is HK$205,000 a year for 2027-28; self-financed programmes are priced separately, from HK$165,000.
Non-local applicants must submit the application themselves; Lingnan says it has authorised no third party for undergraduate admissions.
Dates and entry requirements change by year: read Lingnan's own overseas-applicant pages before you apply.
